author: CrakSEO
name: AI Search Visibility: Brand Mentions in ChatGPT, Perplexity & AI Overviews by CrakSEO
description: AI search visibility for SEO and GEO: check brand mentions in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, and see which sources and citations AI answers use.

tools.name: get_api_credit_balance
tools.description: Free: API credit balance, availability and pricing for SEO data calls. Call first to confirm the connection.

tools.name: get_ai_overview_sources
tools.description: AI Overview sources: whether Google shows an AI Overview for a keyword, its text, every page it cites, and whether a given domain is cited. Costs API credits per call.

keyword.description: Search query exactly as a user would type it.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

location.description: Optional exact location name for city-level results, for example "Austin,Texas,United States". Overrides country.

domain.description: Optional domain to check for a citation, for example example.com.

tools.name: check_chatgpt_brand_mentions
tools.description: ChatGPT brand mentions: ask ChatGPT (with web search) a buyer's question and report whether it mentions your brand, which sources it cites, and whether your domain is cited. Costs API credits per call.

prompt.description: The question a buyer would ask, for example "best seo tools for agencies".

brand.description: Brand name to look for in the answer.

domain.description: Optional brand domain to look for among cited sources.

tools.name: check_perplexity_brand_mentions
tools.description: Perplexity brand mentions: ask Perplexity a buyer's question and report whether it mentions your brand, which sources it cites, and whether your domain is cited. Costs API credits per call.

prompt.description: The question a buyer would ask, for example "best seo tools for agencies".

brand.description: Brand name to look for in the answer.

domain.description: Optional brand domain to look for among cited sources.
